item.title: ❗️ Full autonomy and coordination: during the Echelon 2026 exercise, combat service support units are practising actions taking into account the experience of the special military
item.description: Full autonomy and coordination: during the Echelon 2026 exercise, combat service support units are practising actions taking into account the experience of the special military operation. ❗️ Main objective: improving the coordination of command and control bodies and mastering the practical skills of technical and rear support units during joint operations. 'During the Echelon 2026 exercise, we demonstrate to our colleagues from CSTO countries how we perform combat service support tasks in real combat conditions. The main requirement for the rear area is that it must be fully dug in and camouflaged in the terrain. All premises must be of the bunker type, fully autonomous, equipped with all elements of living, laundry and bath services, and food supply for personnel,' said Sergei Spiridonov, Chief of Staff of the Combat Service Support Directorate of the Central Military District. ⚙️ Special attention during the exercise is paid to the deployment of field refueling points and the organisation of evacuation and repair of damaged equipment under the threat of enemy UAV impact. 🎮 In one of the areas, personnel practised tasks on delivering material resources to the line of contact using unmanned ground vehicles and UAVs, as well as the evacuation of the wounded and damaged equipment. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ▫ Moscow and Baku strengthen military cooperation From 29 to 30 September, a Russian military delegation led by Deputy Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation Vasily Osmakov
item.description: Moscow and Baku strengthen military cooperation From 29 to 30 September, a Russian military delegation led by Deputy Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation Vasily Osmakov made a visit to the Republic of Azerbaijan. ▫ As part of the visit, the delegation took part in the opening ceremony of the ADEX 2026 international defence exhibition, visited the Russian pavilion displaying military products; and talks were held between Deputy Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation Vasily Osmakov and the Minister of Defence of the Republic of Azerbaijan Colonel General Zakir Hasanov. ▫️ During the meeting, the current state of bilateral military cooperation and the prospects for placing it on a comprehensive medium-term footing were discussed, and agreements were reached on continuing the exchange of experience in the organisation of combat training, as well as in the fields of military education and military science. ▫️ The talks took place in a friendly and constructive atmosphere, and their results confirmed a mutual interest in deepening cooperation in the defence sphere in accordance with the Declaration on Allied Interaction between the Russian Federation and the Republic of Azerbaijan dated 22 February 2022. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🏳️ One-way ticket: another prisoner from Skala Brigade Yevgeny Nikitin, a captured AFU serviceman, says he had been mobilised into the AFU.
item.description: 🏳️ One-way ticket: another prisoner from Skala Brigade Yevgeny Nikitin, a captured AFU serviceman, says he had been mobilised into the AFU. Despite a whole 'bouquet' of illnesses, he was quickly found a suitable place of service: 'Lads, you're going to the best brigade — they take absolutely everyone there: the maimed, the disabled, and those with every kind of ailment'. Thus, Nikitin ended up in the 425th Skala Brigade. 💬 The prisoner claims he found himself on the front line as a result of deception. Together with a fellow serviceman, he was sent to deliver food to the line of contact. As it turned out, it was his one-way mission: 'We were supposed to deliver the food and return back to the unit. We were to pull back — and that would have been a fully accomplished task. But they said: 'You two have to stay for a while and you'll go with the next batch.' It turned out I didn't even learn from my own lot that I was already at 'zero' [the front line]'. ✋ 🤚 Nikitin didn't 'fight' for long: on seeing our soldiers, he made the only correct decision — he surrendered immediately: 'When the Russian soldiers appeared, I surrendered. Their treatment towards us was consistent, all along the road — normal: they fed us, gave us cigarettes, didn't mistreat us'. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29723

🏳️
One-way ticket: another prisoner from Skala Brigade
Yevgeny Nikitin, a captured AFU serviceman, says he had been mobilised into the AFU.
Despite a whole 'bouquet' of illnesses, he was quickly found a suitable place of service:
'Lads, you're going to the best brigade — they take absolutely everyone there: the maimed, the disabled, and those with every kind of ailment'. Thus, Nikitin ended up in the 425th Skala Brigade.
💬
The prisoner claims he found himself on the front line as a result of deception. Together with a fellow serviceman, he was sent to deliver food to the line of contact.
As it turned out, it was his one-way mission:
'We were supposed to deliver the food and return back to the unit. We were to pull back — and that would have been a fully accomplished task. But they said: 'You two have to stay for a while and you'll go with the next batch.' It turned out I didn't even learn from my own lot that I was already at 'zero' [the front line]'.
✋
🤚
Nikitin didn't 'fight' for long: on seeing our soldiers, he made the only correct decision — he surrendered immediately:
'When the Russian soldiers appeared, I surrendered. Their treatment towards us was consistent, all along the road — normal: they fed us, gave us cigarettes, didn't mistreat us'.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: . During his speech, Vladimir Putin congratulated Russian citizens on Reunification Day, marking the reunification of the Donetsk and Lugansk people's republics and the Zaporozhye
item.description: During his speech, Vladimir Putin congratulated Russian citizens on Reunification Day, marking the reunification of the Donetsk and Lugansk people's republics and the Zaporozhye and Kherson regions with the Russian Federation on September 30 Exactly four years ago, the Donetsk and Lugansk people's republics and the Zaporozhye and Kherson regions became full-fledged constituent entities of the Russian Federation, returning to the fold of Greater Russia. I am pleased to congratulate all citizens of our country on Unification Day. This holiday has come to embody our people’s unwavering aspiration to restore historical unity and the righteous struggle of the Russian people, the entire country, and the people of Donbass and Novorossiya for freedom and justice, the heroic deeds of the 2014 militias and the heroes of the special military operation who stood up to defend the Motherland and our people. See more on the Kremlin’s official website .

item.title: 🤝 Lending a helping wing In the course of the battles for Khizhnyakovo , the assault detachments of the 344th Motorised Rifle Regiment (6th Guards Combined Arms Army)
item.description: Lending a helping wing 🤝 ▫️ In the course of the battles for Khizhnyakovo , the assault detachments of the 344th Motorised Rifle Regiment (6th Guards Combined Arms Army) acted under the watchful eye and support of UAV operators. A UAV platoon elaborated on it: 'We detected hostile strongholds, hit them to make it easier for our assault detachments to get through. We guided them with the use of the 'birds', and helped them in all sorts of ways. We engaged the enemy by munitions, destroyed a stronghold so that they easily entered the area and mopped up the adversary in the settlement. There were reconnaissance units and Baba Yaga drones of the enemy, all of which were eliminated by our 'birds'. We were also backed by air defence systems. Our scouts, as well as our commander, monitor our units' movement and help to navigate in the area. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ⚓️ Arctic amphibious assault: Northern Fleet's daily routine A detachment of Northern Fleet ships
item.description: ⚓️ Arctic amphibious assault: Northern Fleet's daily routine A detachment of Northern Fleet ships conducted a tactical landing exercise episode on the Sedov Archipelago in the Kara Sea. According to the exercise scenario, an armed group of a mock enemy has taken up positions on Sredniy Island. ▫️ The Northern Fleet's navymen were effective and well-coordinated: ▫️ Helicopter manoeuvre: from the patrol ship Ivan Papanin, a Ka-29 helicopter deployed an air assault detachment from the Separate Guards Marine Brigade on the coast, as well as a post to adjust the ship's artillery fire. ▫️ Technology patrol: before the main assault, the coastline was studied with the help of robotic systems. ▫️ Dry landing: the large landing ship Kondopoga approached the shore, and DT-10PN Vityaz two-section tracked all-terrain vehicles disembarked from its tweendeck. ▫️ Forced march: servicemen successfully gain a bridgehead and moved to the designated area. On the way, a mine action group promptly eliminated all detected mines and munitions. 💥 The servicemen performed all tasks with flying colours. Keep it up! 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
